drafts.title: Year End Function Photographer Johannesburg: Plan Your Shoot
drafts.metaDesc: Need a year end function photographer in Johannesburg? Pick the right package, plan a simple shot list and get great photos of your evening.
drafts.excerpt: Year-end functions peak from late November to mid December. Here is how to pick a package, plan a shot list and get great photos at your Joburg year-end.
drafts.body:
Looking for a year end function photographer in Johannesburg? You are not alone. From late November to mid December, corporate and club year-ends fill up the calendar, and most organisers only start searching for a photographer in the last few weeks.

The good news is that planning your year-end shoot is simple. You just need to know what you want, pick the right package and share a short shot list. Here is how we approach it at FOM Studios.

## Why year-end photos matter for your team and socials

A year-end function is often the one night the whole team is together, dressed up and relaxed. It is a chance to say thank you, hand out awards and celebrate a full year of hard work. Good photos keep that feeling going long after the music stops.

Year-end frames also work hard after the event:

- Your team gets photos they actually want to share
- Your socials get fresh, real content for December and January
- HR and management get images for newsletters and internal updates
- Award winners get a proper photo of their moment on stage

For clubs, the same goes for members and sponsors. A strong set of photos shows people what they missed and gets them excited for next year.

## Photo, video or both: picking the right package

Most year-end functions fit into a 2 hour booking. That covers the busiest part of the night, usually arrivals, speeches, awards and the start of the dance floor. You can see all our options on the [prices page](/prices.html), but here is the short version:

- **Photography from R800 (2 hours):** the best pick if you mainly want photos of people, speeches and awards.
- **Videography from R1000:** a good choice if you want a short cinematic recap to share with the team or post online.
- **Photo and Video from R1500:** you get both, so you have stills for the newsletter and a video for socials.

If your function is smaller, like a team lunch or a short club get-together, the Mini Shoot at R500 gives you 30 minutes with 20 photos or 1 reel. It is a nice option when you just want a few strong frames and a quick reel.

A simple rule: if people will talk, dance or move a lot, video adds a lot of life. If the night is more about awards and group photos, photos alone will do the job well.

## A simple shot list: arrivals, speeches, awards, dance floor

You do not need a long document. A short list helps us know what matters most to you, so nothing important gets missed. Here is a basic year-end shot list you can copy:

- **Arrivals:** guests walking in, welcome drinks, the decor and venue before it fills up
- **Groups:** each team or department together, plus one big group photo if possible
- **Speeches:** the MD, chairperson or club captain on the mic, plus the crowd reacting
- **Awards:** each winner receiving their award, and a quick posed photo after
- **Dance floor:** the moment the energy picks up and people let loose
- **Details:** food, cake, branding, table settings and any special touches

It helps to send us the running order before the night. If the awards start at a set time, we will make sure we are in the right spot. It also helps to have one contact person on the night who knows the plan.

## Lighting tips for evening venues

Most year-ends happen in the evening, often in restaurants, halls or function venues with low, warm lighting. That looks great in person, but it can be tricky on camera. A few small things make a big difference:

- **Keep the stage lit.** If there are speeches or awards, ask the venue to put some light on the stage or podium.
- **Plan the group photo early.** Do it while there is still some daylight, or near the best lit part of the venue.
- **Watch the coloured lights.** Strong red or blue party lights look fun, but they can make faces look strange. Mix them with some normal light if you can.
- **Leave space for the photographer.** A clear path to the front means we can get the shot without blocking anyone.

We bring our own gear for low light, but a well lit stage and a clear running order always give you better frames. You can see the kind of event and party work we do in our [gallery](/gallery.html).

## Book your December date

December fills up fast, and many year-ends land on the same few Fridays and Saturdays. If you already know your date, it is worth locking in your photographer now rather than in the final week.

To book your year-end function shoot, visit [our contact page](/contact.html) or go to fomstudios.co.za. You can also WhatsApp us on 068 690 1120. Send your date, venue and the rough timing of the night, and we will help you pick the right package for your team.

drafts.metaDesc: Looking for a photoshoot gift voucher in Johannesburg? Match a shoot to the person and get 15% off with FOMBLACKFRIDAY from 27 to 30 Nov.
drafts.excerpt: A shoot makes a Christmas gift people remember. Find the right package for a couple, parent, car lover or sporty friend, and save 15% from 27 to 30 November.
drafts.body:
Looking for a photoshoot gift voucher in Johannesburg this Christmas? A shoot is one of those gifts people actually remember. It is time out, a bit of fun and a set of photos they will keep using long after the wrapping paper is gone.

This year there is a bonus. FOM Studios is running 15% off shoots booked from 27 to 30 November for Black Friday. Here is how to pick the right shoot for the right person, and how the deal works.

## Why a shoot beats another gift card

Gift cards are easy, but they often get forgotten in a wallet or spent on something random. A shoot is different. It is an experience with a result at the end: real photos or a reel made just for that person.

A photoshoot gift works well because:

- It is personal, but you do not have to guess their size or taste
- It gives them something to look forward to in the new year
- They end up with photos for their profile, their wall or their socials
- It suits almost anyone, from your partner to your sporty friend

And honestly, most people love good photos of themselves. They just never get around to booking a shoot.

## Which package suits who: Mini Shoot to Photo and Video

Here are some easy matches. You can see all the details on our [prices page](/prices.html).

**For a couple:** A couples shoot at golden hour is a lovely gift for a partner, or for a couple you know. Photography from R800 gives you 2 hours, which is plenty of time to relax and get some natural frames around Joburg.

**For a parent:** Parents rarely get photos of themselves, because they are always the one holding the phone. A Mini Shoot at R500 (30 minutes, 20 photos) is a simple, sweet gift for a mom or dad.

**For a car lover:** If they spend every weekend cleaning their car, a car shoot is the perfect gift. Videography from R1000 gets them a cinematic edit of their ride, or go for Photo and Video from R1500 to get both stills and video.

**For a sporty friend:** Cyclists, runners, padel and soccer players all love action shots. A Mini Shoot with 1 reel is a fun way to show off their sport. For a full session, Photo and Video from R1500 covers both.

Not sure what they would like? A Mini Shoot is the easiest gift to give, because it fits almost any idea.

## How the FOMBLACKFRIDAY 15% off works (27 to 30 Nov)

Black Friday is on 27 November. From 27 to 30 November, FOM Studios is giving 15% off shoots booked in that window. Here is all you need to know:

- Use the code **FOMBLACKFRIDAY** when you book
- The deal is for shoots booked from 27 to 30 November
- It works on our shoot packages, from the Mini Shoot up to Photo and Video

So if you have been thinking about gifting a shoot, or booking one for yourself, those four days are the time to do it.

## Picking a date later is fine

You do not need to know the shoot date right now. You can book during the Black Friday window and choose the actual date later. That makes it perfect as a gift, because the person you are spoiling can pick a day that suits them.

Here are a few tips for gifting it nicely:

- Tell them what kind of shoot it is, so they can get excited
- Let them choose the date and location with us
- Give them a heads up to think about outfits or what to bring

Want to show them what to expect? Send them a link to our [gallery](/gallery.html) so they can see the kind of frames we shoot.

## How to book or gift it

Ready to give a shoot this Christmas? Book online at fomstudios.co.za or via our [contact page](/contact.html), or WhatsApp us on 068 690 1120. Remember to use FOMBLACKFRIDAY between 27 and 30 November for 15% off. Tell us who the shoot is for and what they love, and we will help you pick the best package.

drafts.title: Product Photography Johannesburg: Festive Market Season
drafts.metaDesc: Product photography in Johannesburg for market vendors: get product shots and a short reel around festive markets to boost December sales.
drafts.excerpt: Joburg's festive markets are running back to back. Here is how makers and food vendors can get product shots and a reel that sell before and after a market weekend.
drafts.body:
If you sell at markets, now is the best time to book product photography in Johannesburg. The festive market season is here, and the stalls are running back to back. Customers are out, shopping for gifts, and they are looking at your products both in person and online.

The weeks around a big market weekend are perfect for fresh content. Here is a simple guide for makers and food vendors on getting product shots and a short reel that help you sell before and after the market.

## Why markets are the perfect time for new content

Joburg's festive markets are in full swing. KAMERS/Makers in Sandton runs from 24 to 29 November, the Linden Market Festive Edition is on 28 to 29 November, and the Rosebank Sunday Market is on 29 November.

That means a lot of people will see your brand for the first time. Many will follow you, then check your page later before they buy. If your page has fresh, good looking content, you turn those visitors into December sales.

Markets are also great for content because:

- Your full range is out and looking its best
- Your stall is styled and ready to shoot
- There are real customers, real energy and real moments to capture
- It is a chance to show the people behind the brand

## Product photos vs a short reel: what to get

Both are useful, but they do different jobs.

**Product photos** are best for your online shop, catalogue, menu or WhatsApp business profile. Clean, clear photos of each product help people see exactly what they are buying.

**A short reel** is best for socials. It shows movement, people and the feel of your stall. A reel of you packing an order, plating food or a customer picking up a product does a lot to build trust.

If you can, get a mix. A few clean product frames plus one short reel gives you content for your shop and your socials. Our Mini Shoot at R500 gives you 30 minutes with 20 photos or 1 reel, which is a great starting point. For a longer session, Photography starts from R800 for 2 hours, and Photo and Video starts from R1500. All the options are on our [prices page](/prices.html).

## Shooting your stall: setup, prep and first customer

A little prep makes your shoot go smoothly. Here is what we suggest:

- **Shoot before the rush.** The best time is just after you set up, before the crowds arrive. The stall is neat and there is space to work.
- **Clean and style your products.** Wipe down packaging, fill up display stands and put your best sellers in front.
- **Have your branding visible.** Make sure your banner, logo or signage is in the frame.
- **Plan a few hero products.** Pick 3 to 5 items you most want to sell this December.
- **Capture the first customer.** A real sale, a smile or a handover makes a great moment for a reel.

For food vendors, think about the moment that looks best on camera. It could be steam rising, a pour, or a dish being plated. Those few seconds make the best part of the edit.

## Turning one shoot into a month of posts

One well planned shoot can carry your socials through December. Here is a simple way to spread it out:

- **Week 1:** Post the reel from the market to show the energy and your stall
- **Week 2:** Share product photos, one hero product at a time
- **Week 3:** Use behind the scenes shots of you and your team
- **Week 4:** Run a last minute gift post with your best sellers before Christmas

You can also reuse the product photos on your online shop, WhatsApp catalogue and any flyers. Want to see the kind of work we shoot? Have a look at our [gallery](/gallery.html).

## Book a Mini Shoot or product session

Market weekends move fast, so book early if you want us at your stall. To book a Mini Shoot or a product session, visit fomstudios.co.za or our [contact page](/contact.html), or WhatsApp us on 068 690 1120. Tell us which market you are at, your stall times and what you sell, and we will plan a shoot that fits your brand.
